{{Quote|Sergeant, we've just had our compliance order rescinded. Is this anything to do with your retasking?"''<br />''"What?"''<br />''"Jedi. Our standing order is to comply with any Jedi request. We've just been told to ditch that and to report in if we have any contact with Jedi.|The Coruscant Security officer and Republic Commando Sergeant Darman|<ref name="Order66" />}}
An individual served as a [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|'''Coruscant Security Force''']]''' [[Police officer/Legends|officer]]''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], which condemned all [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as traitors to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the individual was patrolling in a [[Coruscant Security Force assault ship|CSF assault ship]], along with his [[Akk dog/Legends|akk dog]], [[Jossie]], the assault ship's [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], [[Vil (Coruscant Security Force)|Vil]], and [[Clone commando/Legends|Republic Commandos]] [[Darman Skirata|Darman]] and [[Niner Skirata|Niner]]. Upon hearing that the CSF's compliance order for Jedi had been rescinded and they had tried to stage a [[Showdown on Coruscant|coup]], the individual reacted with reserved disgust towards the Jedi, stating that he believed the [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|fire]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] was set by the Jedi themselves, trying to conceal evidence of their [[Treason/Legends|treason]].<ref name="Order66" />

==Behind the scenes==
The individual appeared in ''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]'', written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published on [[September 16]], [[2008]].
